question: Can the licensed chart, three frozen benchmarks and authored census/aggregate tables form a reproducible public dataset?
outcome: 0.3.1: 23 configurations, 3308 rows, 1142 parent-matching PNGs, 137 files/25292479 bytes. All three frozen scores match; 137/137 rebuild files match. Card-only number/classification counts 23/19, 62/55, 71/72; 27 new format cases pass. Independent flags recover 26 earlier units and 16 v3 units; zero strict privacy hits.
challenge: Public prediction keys differed from scorer aliases; independent flags omitted definite changes and used a broader location union than the impact summary. AI references lack expert review; mapped identities and three owner decisions remain open.
remedy: Accept canonical public keys and frozen aliases, reject missing/conflicting/type-invalid values, fill field-specific candidate flags and document the eight extra shape-only joins. Preserve every frozen payload and reviewer file. Correct CFF/model attribution, clarify public documentation and reproduce a byte-identical rebuild.
retry_when: Coordinator uploads and checks 0.3.1 privately; owner confirms issues, private-store terms and final visibility. Check public viewer after approval. Mapped scoring requires reviewed candidate identities and separately frozen expectations.
